results.title: Fire TV Stick and Luna Controller Bundle Is Practically a Giveaway at 56% Off, Putting Console-Free Gaming on Your TV for Less
results.description: The Fire TV Stick 4K Select + Luna Controller bundle is now available at a 56% discount, offering a complete solution for cloud gaming and 4K streaming. The bundle includes the Fire TV Stick 4K Select, which supports 4K UHD and HDR10+, and the Luna Controller, which connects wirelessly to Amazon's servers for low-latency gameplay. This affordable setup allows you to enjoy games and shows on your television without the need for a separate gaming console.

results.title: 19 photos as Sir Kevin Sinfield’s 7 in 7 Grand Finale storms into Castleford on epic York-to-Wakefield run
results.description: Sir Kevin Sinfield and his team brought the third day of their final 7 in 7 challenge to Castleford, running from York to Wakefield as part of a huge fundraising effort supporting people affected by motor neurone disease (MND).

results.title: India vs Pakistan Asian Games 2026 Gold Medal Match: Check Date, Time, Venue, Live Streaming and More
results.description: Team India and Pakistan are set to clash in a historic Gold Medal match at the Asian Games 2026 in Nisshin. This highly anticipated T20I encounter marks their first-ever meeting at the continental games. Fans can watch the fierce rivalry unfold live on the Sony Sports Network and SonyLIV.
